purpose: Make relationship narrative-to-phenotype classification reproducible and chart-blind. The classifier must not see the pair's birth data, HD mechanics, Western synastry, AstroRRF predictions, or candidate/decoy identity while interpreting relationship evidence.

separation_of_roles.prediction_freezer: Reads only independently supplied birth inputs and frozen relationship models; emits anonymous per-question outcome likelihoods/labels before scored answers are collected.
separation_of_roles.interviewer: Asks the frozen relationship question bank one question at a time and preserves verbatim narrative plus non-scored applicability/context metadata.
separation_of_roles.adaptive_selector: Uses only anonymous candidate weights, frozen answer likelihoods for unanswered eligible question ids, expected reliability, and burden. It never receives participant prose, birth metadata, or true candidate identity.
separation_of_roles.evidence_classifier: Reads participant narrative, question target axes, the complete frozen relationship outcome rubric, and minimum-evidence rules, but not any chart prediction.
separation_of_roles.scorer: Compares frozen relationship-model predictions with frozen phenotype classifications after both are sealed.

classifier_inputs: relationship phase/context tags supplied by interviewer
classifier_forbidden_inputs: whether a classification improves model fit

required_axis_output.observability_limits: language, introversion, silence, inexperience, prohibition, opportunity, or other limits

required_question_output.applicability_flags: non-scored fixed vocabulary flags used only for routing
required_question_output.unresolved_axis_ids: axes that remain insufficient or ambiguous

classification_rules: Classify only axes directly supported by the answer; a question targeting several axes need not produce a score for every axis.
Never infer B-to-A internal experience solely from A's assumptions when no behavioral or reported evidence exists; lower confidence or return insufficient evidence.
Never use one actor's attraction as proof of dyadic sexual chemistry.
Never infer baseline libido from low initiation when behavior is constrained by religion, virginity, health, distance, opportunity, or relationship rules.
Never infer Eros/in-love from love, attraction, sex, intimacy, jealousy, or marriage intent alone.
Never infer low intellect from low communication volume, introversion, language limitations, or social-media use.
Keep intellectual compatibility, intellectual stimulation, comprehension/application, knowledge complementarity, and shared interests separate.
Keep mystical salience, mystical curiosity, and mystical stimulation separate.
Keep visible drama/theatricality, serious conflict/hostility, aggression episodes, and repair difficulty separate.
Keep sexual jealousy, romantic-priority jealousy, monogamy preference, and actual relationship structure separate.
A state-dependent curve should be returned when low-distance/high-distance or low-attachment/high-attachment conditions differ materially; do not average them.
Causal interpretations involving supernatural, psychiatric, medical, cultural, or trauma explanations remain separate from the observed behavior unless independently established.
If multiple interpretations fit, return mixed or insufficient evidence rather than choosing the one most favorable to a chart model.

scoring_gate.mixed_policy: Use only a preregistered partial-credit or probability rule; otherwise leave mixed unscored.

development_capture_routing.core_questions: Ask all six frozen core anchors before optional follow-ups unless a question is genuinely not applicable.
development_capture_routing.followup_eligibility: A follow-up may be asked only when one of its frozen applicability flags is present or one of its target axes remains unresolved after the core anchors.
development_capture_routing.chart_access: No chart/model predictions may be used to decide which follow-up to ask in development_capture mode.

validation_adaptive_routing.eligible_pool: unanswered questions allowed by frozen non-scored applicability metadata
validation_adaptive_routing.candidate_weights: anonymous candidate/decoy posterior or equal prior weights maintained outside the classifier
stop_rules: No eligible unanswered question has positive adjusted utility.
Prespecified maximum burden/question count is reached.
The declared candidate discrimination target is already reached.

freeze_requirements: classifier model identifier/version and sampling settings
per-question burden and expected reliability defaults
candidate/decoy prediction matrix or likelihood package
model/version hashes for HD, Western, AstroRRF, and any non-symbolic baseline being compared
participant response record hash before chart reveal/evaluation
